[30 days]{.lit-num}

[One month of continuous records from 62 California stations, recorded for earthquake monitoring and kept in open archives, gave surface-wave maps from ambient noise.]{.lit-msg}

[Shapiro, N. M., Campillo, M., Stehly, L., & Ritzwoller, M. H. (2005). High-resolution surface-wave tomography from ambient seismic noise. *Science*, 307, 1615–1618.]{.lit-cite}
:::

::: {.lit-card}
[> 3 PB]{.lit-num}

[CMIP5 output from about 20 modeling groups, expected to exceed 3 PB, is written in one common format, so one analysis can read every model.]{.lit-msg}

[Taylor, K. E., Stouffer, R. J., & Meehl, G. A. (2012). An overview of CMIP5 and the experiment design. *Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society*, 93, 485–498.]{.lit-cite}
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.lit-card}
[17,000]{.lit-num}

[NGL collects GNSS data from more than 130 archives, processes every station the same way, and publishes the positions as plain text files.]{.lit-msg}

[Blewitt, G., Hammond, W. C., & Kreemer, C. (2018). Harnessing the GPS data explosion for interdisciplinary science. *Eos*, 99, doi:10.1029/2018EO104623.]{.lit-cite}
:::

::: {.lit-card}
[19.6%]{.lit-num .bad}

[Spreadsheet defaults turned gene names into dates in 704 of 3,597 genomics papers with gene lists in Excel supplements.]{.lit-msg}

[Ziemann, M., Eren, Y., & El-Osta, A. (2016). Gene name errors are widespread in the scientific literature. *Genome Biology*, 17, 177.]{.lit-cite}
